scope: Development-set REE family adjudication against the current catalog and publication-eligible child sidecar.

label_definitions.direct_ree_fit: The source explicitly supports rare-earth or lanthanide technical R&D.
label_definitions.broad_program_fit: The authoritative source supports a program area broad enough for rare-earth technical R&D, but does not explicitly name the target in the indexed scope.
label_definitions.method_only_broad_fit: The source supports a relevant method but supplies no rare-earth target evidence; it must not satisfy a target-plus-method query by itself.
label_definitions.irrelevant: The source does not support rare-earth technical R&D for the query family.
